item.coloph: yer pa'i gter phud du dran pas gsang rgya'o//

'di'i brgyud pa ni/ mtshan ldan 'gro ba'i mgon po li shu pa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro co za/ dam can bya ra ma gsum/ gter ston bzhod ston dngos grub grags/ rgyal ston jo lde zhig po/ zhig po snang seng / skyo ston sngags dpal/ g.yo ston dngos grub seng ge/ zhig po 'brug sgra seng ge/ dgyes rang g.yo ston blo lde/ rtogs ldan g.yung drung rin chen/ mkhas btsun shes rab grub pa/ 'gu ru yon tan seng ge/ rang grol sprul sku chen po bla ma rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa'i rgyal thebs blo gros bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ rim par brgyud pa'o//
